title: A Complete Makefile
description: A Makefile that gives every contributor one interface: run one file, run all tests, regenerate the expected files, and clean up.

steps.description: The page says to save this as `Makefile` at the root of your project, and that indented lines must use a real tab character. `INTERP` holds the interpreter command, `EXT` holds the file extension, `TESTS` expands `$(wildcard tests/*$(EXT))` to every matching file, and `NAMES` strips the directory with `$(notdir)` and the extension with `$(basename)`.
`run` runs the interpreter on one file, the path passed in `FILE`.
`test` depends on one `test-` target per test name. The `test-%` pattern rule echoes the test name, then runs `diff` between the interpreter's output and the expected file, printing `PASS` or `FAIL`.
`generate-expected` loops over every test file, strips the extension, and writes the interpreter's output to the matching expected file.
`clean` removes `__pycache__` directories. `.PHONY` marks the four targets as names that are not files, so Make always runs their recipes.
